name: Admissibility Space Registry
purpose: Define admissibility sets, admissibility distance or constraint measure, admissible image, and boundary behavior.

admissibility_definitions.informal_role: local admissibility set or constraint region
admissibility_definitions.definition: The subset of state space satisfying local continuation constraints.
A measure of the distance of a state from the nearest admissible configuration.
The projection of the local admissibility set into an observable domain.
The limit set of the admissibility region where continuation risk is critical.

mandatory_rules.rule: Admissibility is local unless explicitly marked otherwise.
Non-empty admissible image (MT-003) is a theorem target, not an assumption.
Boundary behavior must explicitly include failure cases (e.g., orientation locking).

governance_rules.rule: All admissibility objects must maintain NON_PHYSICAL and ANALOG_ONLY status.

forbidden_claims: Admissibility distance derives physical force laws.
